info.title: Autonomous Job Search Agent
info.description:
Ingest public Greenhouse and Lever listings, run deterministic hard filters, evaluate jobs with JobEvaluationAgent, and review results in the dashboard.

The review UI is served at `/`. Interactive docs are at `/docs` (Swagger UI) and `/redoc`. Human Approve/Review/Reject decisions do not submit applications.

get.description: Return the primary profile with grounded field provenance.
Return atomic claims the evaluation agent may cite.

post.description: Insert a listing. Duplicate source + source_job_id returns 409.
Score a listing. Default `evaluation_mode` is `live_llm` (requires OPENAI_API_KEY).
Deterministic knock-outs vs the primary candidate. Missing salary does not fail.
Evaluate unevaluated jobs in-process. Default `evaluation_mode` is `live_llm`.

get.description: Counts for discovered, evaluated, recommended, review, submitted, interviews, and offers.
Evaluated jobs for human review. Defaults to US-eligible locations.
Description, evaluation, cited evidence, hard-filter result, and application URL.

post.description: Store approve, review, or reject. Does not submit an application.
Fetch `boards-api.greenhouse.io` jobs for a public board token and upsert.
Fetch `api.lever.co` postings for a public site slug and upsert.

discovered_after.title: Discovered After
discovered_after.description: Inclusive lower bound on job discovered_at (UTC).

discovered_before.title: Discovered Before
discovered_before.description: Inclusive upper bound on job discovered_at (UTC).

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Max jobs to pick up. Defaults to EVALUATION_BATCH_LIMIT_DEFAULT.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run hard filters only; do not call the model or persist evaluations.

reevaluate.title: Reevaluate
reevaluate.description: Include jobs that already have an evaluation.

evaluation_mode.description: live_llm requires OPENAI_API_KEY. offline_rubric and mock must be explicit.

agent_usage_rule.title: Agent Usage Rule
agent_usage_rule.default: Never invent candidate experience. Use evidence_backed values as facts, treat derived values as interpretations that must stay faithful to cited evidence, and treat unknown values as missing information.
